request: Generate a 2d reference image with front, top, side of the interceptor spaceship

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 2D orthographic spaceship reference sheet for modeling the existing Stellar Syndicates Interceptor.
Primary request: Create ONE polished reference image showing exactly THREE consistent views of the SAME interceptor: TOP, FRONT, and SIDE.

Input images:
Image 1 is the authoritative TOP-DOWN design reference. Preserve its silhouette and proportions, nose, wing planform, cockpit, engine arrangement, weapon positions and armor-panel language.
Image 2 is supporting three-quarter reference for the SAME ship, useful only for understanding volume, thickness and materials. Do not copy its camera angle.

Subject identity: compact light interceptor with a long narrow chisel nose; elongated dark smoked cockpit with narrow brass surround; two broad swept split-delta pale-silver wings with notched roots and small raised outer tip fins; a pair of cylindrical aft engine nacelles separated by a tapering center spine; two compact forward-facing weapon mounts alongside the cockpit; dark gunmetal understructure; restrained warm brass fittings; slim cyan running lights. Faithfully derive the design from the provided images, without redesigning it.

Layout: generous landscape canvas, a professional clean reference sheet on plain off-white. Large TOP view occupying the left half, nose pointing straight UP. FRONT elevation in the upper-right, camera looking straight at the nose at zero elevation. SIDE elevation in the lower-right, nose pointing LEFT. Keep all three complete and uncropped, generous white space separating drawings and labels. Match scale between projections: top and side lengths match, top and front spans match, front and side heights match. Modest title at top left and simple small labels below their respective drawings. No extra fourth view.

Style: precisely drawn 2D hard-surface concept drafting, crisp thin charcoal outlines, flat pale titanium / gunmetal color blocking, very restrained soft gray shading only to clarify volume, sparse brass and cyan accents. Clean contours and readable panel seams, suitable as a 3D modeling guide. No photorealistic beauty render. No dramatic lighting or texture noise.

Projection rules: TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC projections, with parallel lines and zero perspective or foreshortening. The FRONT view must be a shallow, horizontally spread head-on elevation, showing the pointed nose head-on, raised cockpit canopy, thin wings and the two small forward weapon apertures; do NOT show rear exhaust circles facing the viewer in front view. The SIDE view is a strict flat profile with visible upper and lower contours, cockpit rise, chisel nose, wing thickness, and the near cylindrical aft engine; far paired parts overlap correctly. Infer hidden lower hull geometry conservatively from the existing shape. The TOP is directly overhead, bilaterally symmetric, retaining the reference's exact broad wing silhouette. Keep the geometry and relative feature positions consistent across views.

Text (verbatim): "INTERCEPTOR", "TOP", "FRONT", "SIDE".
Constraints: only these three ship drawings and four text labels; no dimensions or invented specifications, no perspective inset, no rear view, no cutaway, no exploded parts, no stars, no scenery, no grid, no watermark, no ground, no drop shadows, no landing gear, no exhaust flames, no visible pilot. High native resolution with sharp fine detail.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 2D orthographic reference sheet.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly generated three-view Interceptor reference sheet.
Image 2 is the original ship identity reference only.

Fix ONLY the incorrect camera projections in the three-view sheet. Keep the exact ship design, white background, layout, title "INTERCEPTOR", the three labels "TOP", "FRONT", "SIDE", colors, panel language, and fine 2D illustration quality.

The existing FRONT panel is WRONG because it is an overhead view compressed vertically, with a long nose behind the cockpit and a tail-like point pointing down. Replace that FRONT drawing entirely with a geometrically correct straight HEAD-ON orthographic elevation of the same very FLAT spacecraft. The camera is AT NOSE HEIGHT, on the ship's centerline, with ZERO elevation and ZERO yaw. Ship points straight OUT of the page. Its length axis collapses to zero in this projection. The drawing must be shallow and wide, about 5 to 6 times as wide as it is high. Wings are two narrow edge-on horizontal silver strips. Show a small low faceted nose tip in the center, dark canopy arch peeking above it, two forward-facing small gun muzzles next to the central hull, flat lower belly, and short wingtip fins. The nose tip is in front of the canopy and centered slightly below it. Do not show the long dorsal nose blade, a top-down canopy interior, the center tail spine, the wing upper surfaces, longitudinal gun barrels, or any exhaust glow. Fore/aft forms overlap each other in this head-on view. Match the front span to the TOP span.

The existing SIDE panel is WRONG because it shows a broad wing upper surface and both wingtip fins. Replace that SIDE drawing entirely with a true EXACT LEFT SIDE orthographic profile, ZERO elevation and ZERO yaw. Nose points LEFT. Horizontal length axis. Near and far symmetrical geometry overlaps perfectly: only ONE engine outline, ONE wingtip-fin silhouette, ONE weapon side-profile. Wings are viewed completely edge-on and appear as thin horizontal slabs; no broad trapezoidal upper wing surface visible. Show a long low chisel nose, small raised dark canopy, shallow gunmetal belly, silver side armor, the compact forward weapon in profile, horizontal aft cylindrical engine in perfect side profile with a vertical rear nozzle lip at the right edge. One modest tip fin as implied by the original design, no new tall dorsal tail. No undercarriage.

TOP panel: preserve the exact planform and top panels. Flatten any residual perspective: camera directly overhead, tail engines shown as cylindrical top profiles ending in narrow rear rims, NOT forward-facing circular exhaust openings. All three must read as precisely aligned views of ONE identical object, consistent scale and dimensions. Top hull length equals side hull length. Top wingspan equals front wingspan.

Keep it an elegant clean 2D colored technical drawing with crisp contours and restrained flat shading. No additional views, perspective, isometric views, dramatic rendering, annotations, numbers, grid, shadows, new parts or changes to design.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied 2D Interceptor orthographic reference sheet with ONE small precise correction.

In the lower-right drawing labeled SIDE, remove the erroneous tall swept vertical tail fin that rises above the rear engine at the extreme upper-right of that drawing, including its long raised backward-running boom above the engine. This tail does not exist on the original craft. Replace its area with the same clean white background and restore a simple LOW continuous upper rear-fuselage / engine contour. The upper rear hull must stay below the top of the cockpit canopy. Keep the horizontal cylindrical rear engine.

Retain the SMALL existing near-side wingtip fin beside the lower half of the engine, with its cyan slit. In a strict side projection, the identical far-side wingtip fin is fully occluded by the near-side fin. There should therefore be exactly ONE short cyan wingtip-fin silhouette visible in SIDE, and NO tall dorsal tail fin.

Preserve EVERYTHING else, including the TOP drawing, FRONT drawing, all four exact text labels, all placement and scales, colors, contours, weapons, cockpit, panel lines, white background and clean 2D technical illustration finish. Do not alter the FRONT or TOP at all. The side remains strictly profile with nose left.
